[[Scorch Maulclaw]] is the one who has captured [[Pyre Fierceshot]]'s warband. He is accompanied with some other [[Charr]] and defeating him is part of [[The Dawn of Rebellion]] quest. If you defeat him, the cinematic plays and you can enter [[Doomlore Shrine]]. 

==Locations==
*[[Charr Homelands]]
**{{NPC location|Dalada Uplands}} (only during [[The Dawn of Rebellion]])

*{{Skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
*{{Skill icon|Breath of Fire}}
*{{Skill icon|Fire Storm}}
*{{Skill icon|Meteor Shower}}
*{{Skill icon|Mind Blast}} ([[elite]])
*{{monster skill icon|Whirling Fires}}

==Notes==
*You can't capture [[Mind Blast]] from him because the cinematic plays when you defeat him.
